title: Microsoft FAT Specification
question: Does a fixed high reserved range take precedence over geometry-derived next-cluster values near FAT type cutoffs?
finding: This selected supplier document defines the next-cluster range through the geometry-derived maximum valid cluster number and the following reserved range through the bad-marker predecessor. The current decoder and global oracle follow that definition. No code change is justified by the suspected fixed-range mismatch.
limits: This source check does not qualify another FAT variant, operating-system consumer, legacy host, physical device or writer. Consumer compatibility remains an explicit separate gate.
